name: Saber
story: A swordsman in pursuit of invincibility, used by Laboratory 1718.

skills.name: Enemy's Bane
skills.desc: Each time Saber deals damage, he reduces the target's Physical Defense by 3-8 for 5s (up to 5 stacks).

skills.name: Orbiting Swords
skills.desc: Saber releases 5 swords that orbit around him and deal 80 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies on hit. The swords will retract back to him after the duration. While active, Sword attacks deal 210 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and 50% damage to enemies along the path (damage reduced to 50% against minions). Each sword attack also reduces the cooldown of Charge by 1s.

skills.name: Charge
skills.desc: Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. After the dash, his next Basic Attack is enhanced, allowing him to dash to the target, dealing 75 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

skills.name: Triple Sweep
skills.desc: Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2s (unaffected by Resilience). He strikes them 3 times over the duration, dealing 120 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with the first 2 strikes and 240 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with the third.
